prose: What if everything we’ve been taught about sound, electromagnetism, and the nature of space is missing a key piece? In this electrifying livestream, Chance Garton is joined by Eileen McKusick, Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs, and Topher Gardner of Biocharisma to dive deep into the mysteries of frequency, plasma physics, bioelectric health, and the true nature of sound.
This conversation will shift your perception of reality and reveal how sound, frequency, and charge influence everything from personal health to cosmic forces.
topics: The charged nature of air: why we’re always immersed in a weak plasma
Sound as an electromagnetic force, challenging mainstream physics
Why space is not a vacuum but an electric ocean of plasma waves
The connection between bioelectric health, herbs, and vitality
The tuning fork effect: how sound waves interact with charge in the environment
The hidden history of Maxwell’s equations and what was lost in modern electromagnetism
